## Load

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(forcats)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)

df <- read_excel("dataset_inmigracion_scraped.xlsx")
ia <- read_excel("dataset_inmigracion_synthetic.xlsx")

ia <- ia %>%
  mutate(medio = "sintetico")

df <- bind_rows(df, ia)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    etiqueta = recode(etiqueta, "ALERTA" = "VERDADERO"),
    fecha_publicacion = ymd_hms(fecha_publicacion),
    year = year(fecha_publicacion),
    month = floor_date(fecha_publicacion, "month"),
    titulo = str_squish(as.character(titulo)),
    texto = str_squish(as.character(texto)),
    n_palabras_titulo = str_count(titulo, boundary("word")),
    n_palabras_texto = str_count(texto, boundary("word")),
    n_caracteres_texto = nchar(texto)
  )


df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    medio = str_squish(str_to_lower(medio)),
    medio = if_else(str_detect(medio, "^tag"), "maldita migración", medio)
  )
```

```{r}
non_article_check <- df %>%
  mutate(
    non_article = str_detect(
      texto,
      regex(
        paste(
          "Todas las noticias sobre",
          "Últimas noticias",
          "Noticias de última hora",
          "Consulta las últimas noticias",
          "Toda la actualidad",
          "Información y noticias",
          "publicadas en EL PAÍS",
          sep = "|"
        ),
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )
  )

non_article_check %>%
  count(non_article)

df <- non_article_check %>%
  filter(non_article == FALSE) %>%
  select(-non_article)
```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    tecnica = replace_na(as.character(tecnica), "ninguna"),
    modificacion = replace_na(as.character(modificacion), "ninguna")
  )
```



## Plot 1: topic by media

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
media_topic <- df %>%
  count(medio, tema) %>%
  group_by(medio) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(media_topic, aes(x = fct_reorder(tema, prop, .fun = max), 
                        y = fct_reorder(medio, prop, .fun = max), 
                        fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(labels = percent_format(), low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Topic distribution by media outlet",
    x = "Topic",
    y = "Media outlet",
    fill = "Proportion",
    caption = "Numbers inside cells represent article counts."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Plot 2: label by media 

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
media_label <- df %>%
  count(medio, etiqueta) %>%
  group_by(medio) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(media_label, aes(x = fct_reorder(medio, prop, .fun = max), 
                        y = prop, 
                        fill = etiqueta)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Label distribution by media",
    x = "Media outlet",
    y = "Proportion of articles",
    fill = "Label"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = etiqueta, y = n_palabras_texto, fill = etiqueta)) +

```

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    year = if_else(medio == "sintetico", 2026L, as.integer(year))
  )

year_media <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(year), year >= 2000, year <= 2026) %>%
  count(year, medio)

ggplot(year_media, aes(x = year, y = n, color = medio)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(2017, 2026),
    breaks = seq(2017, 2026, by = 2)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Temporal distribution of articles by media outlet",
    x = "Publication year",
    y = "Number of articles",
    color = "Media outlet"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = n_palabras_titulo, 
               y = n_palabras_texto, 
               color = etiqueta)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship between title length and article length",
    x = "Number of words in title",
    y = "Number of words in text, log scale",
    color = "Label"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
install.packages("tidytext")
library(tidytext)

stopwords_es <- tibble(
  word = c(
    "de", "la", "el", "en", "y", "a", "los", "las", "un", "una",
    "que", "por", "con", "del", "al", "se", "no", "es", "para",
    "su", "sus", "sobre", "como", "más", "ha", "han", "lo"
  )
)

title_words <- df %>%
  select(etiqueta, titulo) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, titulo) %>%
  filter(str_detect(word, "^[a-záéíóúñü]+$")) %>%
  anti_join(stopwords_es, by = "word") %>%
  count(etiqueta, word, sort = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(etiqueta) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 15) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(title_words, aes(x = reorder_within(word, n, etiqueta), 
                        y = n, 
                        fill = etiqueta)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ etiqueta, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Most frequent title words by label",
    x = "Word",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
